facts: Neutral quantified obligation position; immutable admitted source, allocation chain, event, commit and optional ledger association.
operations: Open position; admit typed source; materialize; settle; reverse; inspect by effective/knowledge time; link independent ledger posting.
invariants: One position per obligation, one source per FulfillmentEnd, one commit per source; no duplicated AR/AP facts.
Only serialized commit seals confer authority; every temporal prefix has 0 <= settled <= materialized <= quantified obligation.
Trusted typed domain admission is required and rechecked, including original publication knowledge time.
Exact decimal6; explicit unit; no floating point, implicit exchange, invoice authority or ledger-as-payment proof.

acceptance.description: Outstanding reciprocal obligation can materialize into a settlement position.
One position supports partial settlement by multiple events.
One event can settle multiple positions where policy permits.
Remaining/open amount is derivable and temporally explainable.
Invoice/document is representation/communication rather than the underlying authoritative position.
Model is clearly distinguished from adjudication Claim in #44.
Fixtures cover commerce payment, reimbursement, and one non-money credit example.
Source-bound invariant and concurrency receipts on PostgreSQL, hosted D1 and hosted DynamoDB.
Semantic compiler / ConceptIR temporal bridge with #75; package-level temporal fields alone do not satisfy this integration.
